title: [3.0-rc3] no button for catheter/reservoir/pod change
symptom: The user reports that after changing an Omnipod pod, they want to give an extra bolus of 1.8 IE to fill the needle, but there is no button in the action tab for catheter/reservoir/pod change. The algorithm treats this extra bolus as a normal bolus and reduces basal rate incorrectly.
cause: The button is not present because Omnipod does not support priming at all; having it could be confusing for most people. The user's extra bolus is not recognized as a prime/fill, so it affects the algorithm.
fix: A workaround is to add the insulin as a bolus and then remove it from the treatment history via the treatment dialog (option menu, treatments) so the algorithm does not use it to calculate basal rate. Another workaround mentioned is to enter a few carbs to avoid confusing the loop.
evidence_quote: a work around is; do add the insulin, like would do as a bolus. Thereafter you remove the in the treatment dialog (via de option menu, treatments), When remove it from the history and the algo will not use it the calculate the basal rate.
